messages:
emma-support: Heads-up: Nimbus customer (org 582) says objects deleted on 2025-08-12T02:15:30Z still show in search at 2025-08-12T08:40:00Z. delete API returned 202 and tombstone in storage, but search/index shows item.
emma-support: Suspect relation to last-night KMS rotation (hsm-key-7). Attaching minimal repro below.
emma-support: ```
# delete
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/delete \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -d '{\"org_id\":582,\"object_id\":\"nimbus-msg-abc123\"}'
# response: {\"status\":\"accepted\",\"deleted_at\":\"2025-08-12T02:15:30Z\"}
# then immediately:
curl \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/search?q=abc123&org_id=582\"
# response: shows object with \"deleted\": false
```
josh-eng: pinging @priya-sre — do we have indexer errors around 02:15-09:00 UTC?
priya-sre: I see the key-rotation job ran at 02:10 UTC, rewrap finished 02:13 but indexer logs show repeated decrypt failures 02:14-02:17: `decrypt error: INVALID_AUTH_TAG` for key=hsm-key-7 :eyes: 
priya-sre: Indexer treats decrypt failures as transient and retries, but we have a backlog spike right after rotation. metrics: indexer_tombstone_lag_seconds peaked at 2.6e4 (~7 hours).
josh-eng: can you paste the exact indexer log snippet?
priya-sre: ```
2025-08-12T02:14:05Z indexer-3 ERROR decrypt failed object=nimbus-msg-abc123 err=\"INVALID_AUTH_TAG\" key=hsm-key-7
2025-08-12T02:14:06Z indexer-3 WARN skip tombstone enqueue object=nimbus-msg-abc123
``` 
emma-support: customer shows audit log entry with encryption_key_id: `projects/prod/keys/hsm-key-7` and tombstone marker in storage manifest. So storage and audit agree, index doesn't.
legal-ops: If index exposure persists we need to offer preservation export and a corrective timeline. Is there an ETA on full catch-up?
priya-sre: We're planning a forced reindex for the affected shard with a small hotfix that retries decrypt with fallback key versions. Estimated catch-up 1-3 hours after start. Will run in maintenance window and notify.
josh-eng: steps for reproable check for support: run delete call, then poll `GET /admin/indexer/status?shard=...` and `GET /objects/:id/metadata` — if metadata.deleted_at present but indexer reports tombstone_lag > 0 then object visible. Example commands:
josh-eng: ```
# check metadata
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" \
  \"https://console.redwood.ai/internal/objects/nimbus-msg-abc123/metadata\"
# check indexer status
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" \
  \"https://console.redwood.ai/internal/indexer/status?shard=us-east-2\"
```
emma-support: i'm going to offer Nimbus an interim preservation export and a customer-facing timeline. assigning owners: @priya-sre to run forced reindex, @josh-eng to ship retry fallback patch, @emma-support to coordinate comms. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy queued: indexer-fallback-retry v1.2.9 -> staging
emma-support: will update thread with progress and export link once ready.
